bottleneck.description: Only scaled US mine-to-magnet NdPr producer; sole operator of Mountain Pass (the only US rare earth mine) with DoD-backed integrated separation and Fort Worth/Independence magnet build-out.

dependency.key_customers: US DoD (price-floor offtake), GM, Independence magnet customers; Chinese sales (Shenghe) ceased July 2025
dependency.key_suppliers: Internal Mountain Pass concentrate; reagents from US chemical suppliers

editorial.notes: MP operates the only commercially producing US rare earth mine and is the West's only vertically integrated mine-to-magnet NdPr entity outside China. The July 2025 DoD partnership (10-year $110/kg NdPr floor, $400M preferred equity, $150M heavy rare earth separation loan, 10X magnet facility commissioning 2028) cements its strategic-bottleneck status for US defense and EV magnet sovereignty. Lynas is the only credible substitute outside China; otherwise the West has no scaled alternative, hence HIGH rather than CRITICAL (a viable alternative exists in Lynas).
